#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a project kickoff meeting calendar entry for next Monday, 10:00-12:00 local time."""
import datetime as dt
import os
import sys
import uuid

OUT_PATH = "project_kickoff.ics"


def next_monday(today):
    """Return the Monday strictly after `today` (next week's Monday if today is Monday)."""
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # weekday(): Mon=0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + dt.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def detect_tz_name():
    """Best-effort detection of the system's IANA timezone name; fall back to UTC."""
    tz = os.environ.get("TZ")
    if tz and tz not in ("", "UTC", "GMT", "Etc/UTC"):
        return tz
    try:
        if os.path.islink("/etc/localtime"):
            target = os.readlink("/etc/localtime")
            marker = "/usr/share/zoneinfo/"
            if target.startswith(marker):
                return target[len(marker):]
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "UTC"


# --- Compute event times -----------------------------------------------------
start_date = next_monday(dt.date.today())
start_local = dt.datetime(start_date.year, start_date.month, start_date.day, 10, 0)
end_local = start_local + dt.timedelta(hours=2)
now_utc = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
tz_name = detect_tz_name()
uid = f"project-kickoff-{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"

dtstamp = now_utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
if tz_name == "UTC":
    dtstart = f"DTSTART:{start_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}Z"
    dtend = f"DTEND:{end_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}Z"
else:
    dtstart = f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{start_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}"
    dtend = f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{end_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}"

# --- Build the ICS file (prefer icalendar lib, fall back to manual format) ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
    HAS_ICALENDAR = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_ICALENDAR = False

if HAS_ICALENDAR:
    import zoneinfo
    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")
    cal.add("method", "PUBLISH")

    tz = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz_name) if tz_name != "UTC" else dt.timezone.utc
    event = Event()
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("dtstamp", now_utc)
    event.add("dtstart", start_local.replace(tzinfo=tz))
    event.add("dtend", end_local.replace(tzinfo=tz))
    event.add("summary", "Project Kickoff Meeting")
    event.add("description", "Kickoff meeting for the new project.")
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("sequence", 0)

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes.")
    alarm.add("trigger", dt.timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    payload = cal.to_ical()
else:
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        dtstart,
        dtend,
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the new project.",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes.",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    payload = ("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n").encode("utf-8")

with open(OUT_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(payload)

# --- Validate by re-reading the generated file ------------------------------
if HAS_ICALENDAR:
    from icalendar import Calendar as ParseCal
    with open(OUT_PATH, "rb") as f:
        parsed = ParseCal.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(events) == 1, f"expected 1 VEVENT, got {len(events)}"
    ev = events[0]
    assert ev.get("summary") == "Project Kickoff Meeting"
    assert ev.get("dtend").dt > ev.get("dtstart").dt, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"
    validation = "PASS (re-parsed with icalendar; DTEND > DTSTART)"
else:
    with open(OUT_PATH, "rb") as f:
        text = f.read().decode("utf-8")
    required = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "END:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "END:VEVENT",
                "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY:"]
    missing = [r for r in required if r not in text]
    assert not missing, f"missing required fields: {missing}"
    validation = "PASS (basic field/format check; icalendar lib not installed)"

print(f"ICS file written: {OUT_PATH}")
print(f"  Meeting        : Project Kickoff Meeting")
print(f"  Date           : {start_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")
print(f"  Start (local)  : {start_local.strftime('%I:%M %p')} {tz_name}")
print(f"  End (local)    : {end_local.strftime('%I:%M %p')} {tz_name}")
print(f"  Duration       : 2 hours")
print(f"  Reminder       : 15 minutes before")
print(f"  Status         : CONFIRMED")
print(f"  Timezone used  : {tz_name} (detected from system; edit if this is not yours)")
print(f"  Validation     : {validation}")
